title: The Ritual Foundation

The Record Keepers deploy the Tradition Resistance Trial, manifesting the Ritual Foundation where excellence-honoring becomes necessity. symbolism: The Six of Cups represents tradition and cultural legacy—honoring established excellence. The Ritual Foundation embodies the choice between innovation-only and tradition-honoring. Two approaches appear: breakthrough-only (maintaining innovation-first avoiding tradition-honoring) versus stagnation-only (honoring only traditions proving stagnation), with excellence-tradition integrating innovation with proven-foundation.
